newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian soybean prices fall on rising arrivals.
newsitem.headline: Indian soybean prices fall on rising arrivals.

text.p: Indian soybean prices fell in central markets on rising arrivals on Wednesday, dealers said.
Prices fell by 100-150 rupees per tonne while arrivals rose to 15,000 tonnes, up sharply from 8,000 tonnes on Tuesday.
Dealers said due to a cash shortage demand from processing plants was limited while undertone was steady.
Soyoil prices were firm on limited supply against better local demand while soymeal and rapeseed extraction prices were steady in thin trade.

Soymeal yellow was $265 for ready shipment and was $263-264 per tonne FAS (Free Alongside Ship) for January-February shipment. Rapeseed extraction was $135 per tonne in export. Rapeseed extraction was 4,600 rupees FOR Bedibunder and was 4,550-4,575 rupees FOR Bhavnagar.
